<finding task="2"><quote>`exclude-newer` set to the RFC 3339 timestamp of 00:00:00Z on the day after the freeze date</quote><plan>    @property
    def cutoff(self) -> str:
        '''00:00:00Z on the freeze date, so uv resolves as of the start of that day.'''
        return f'{self.freeze:%Y-%m-%d}T00:00:00Z'</plan><fix>Make `cutoff` return `(self.freeze + datetime.timedelta(days=1))` formatted as `%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z`, so files uploaded on the freeze date (UTC) are included. Change `test_cutoff_is_midnight_utc_on_the_freeze_date` to expect `'2026-10-20T00:00:00Z'` and `'2027-01-01T00:00:00Z'`. Update every test that spells the cutoff, including the `uv.toml` text test and the bump, run and late-pin tests (for example, an upload at 2026-10-19 must now pass). Rewrite the `uv.toml` comment, the Labels entry and the Global Constraints line "The cutoff falls at the start of the freeze date" to say the cutoff is the start of the day after the freeze date.</fix></finding>
